title: Numerical Evaluation of ZX Calculus Optimization for Solovay Kitaev Quantum Circuit Synthesis
summary: Fault-tolerant architectures implement non-Clifford T gates through magic-state distillation, so the T-count of a synthesized circuit dominates its physical cost. The Solovay-Kitaev algorithm approximates any single-qubit unitary from a finite gate set with a sequence length that grows only polylogarithmically in the inverse target error, but it optimizes for numerical convergence rather than circuit economy, and its output carries structural redundancy that a gate-level compiler cannot see. We report a measurement of what diagrammatic post-processing recovers from that redundancy. Twelve…
